overview: Navigating complex corporate regulations and commercial agreements requires meticulous drafting, proactive compliance, and deep industry knowledge. Basunia & Associates provides strategic counsel to multinational corporations, startups, and financial institutions.

sections.heading: Strategic Commercial Transactions & Contracts
sections.body: In today's fast-evolving business landscape, contracts form the bedrock of corporate success. We draft, review, and negotiate joint venture agreements, shareholder pacts, distribution arrangements, and technology transfers to mitigate commercial risks and preserve business relationships.

sections.heading: Mergers, Acquisitions & Due Diligence
sections.body: Our M&A practice covers every stage of acquisition and divestiture. From preliminary regulatory clearance to exhaustive legal due diligence and closing, our team ensures complete statutory compliance with the Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC) and Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC).

sections.heading: Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance
sections.body: We guide board members and executives on compliance with company laws, anti-money laundering frameworks, ESG guidelines, and annual filing protocols, shielding organizations from potential legal liabilities.

keyTakeaways: Bespoke contract drafting tailored to regional and international jurisdictions.
Thorough risk assessment and regulatory due diligence before major transactions.
Comprehensive corporate compliance support across all operational tiers.

overview: Preserving generational wealth and resolving sensitive family matters demands empathy, confidentiality, and deep legal proficiency. We assist high-net-worth families and individuals in safeguarding their legacy.

sections.heading: Wills, Trusts & Generational Succession
sections.body: Crafting enforceable testamentary documents and private trusts ensures asset transfer according to your wishes. Our team structures estate plans in adherence with personal statutory laws, minimizing future probate conflicts.

sections.heading: Probate Administration & Letters of Administration
sections.body: We represent clients before the District Courts and High Court Division for obtaining probate and letters of administration, navigating complex heirship challenges with speed and precision.

sections.heading: Family Settlements & Dispute Resolution
sections.body: When familial disputes arise over inherited property or marital separations, we prioritize private mediation and structured settlements to protect family dignity and financial interests.

keyTakeaways: Customized wills and trusts aligned with personal religious and civil laws.
Smooth probate proceedings with complete litigation support if contested.
Discreet family mediation for peaceful wealth and asset partition.
